text:
Owen R: Quick sync  I'm putting together a tiny migration cheat-sheet for customers moving from legacy `reserved_pool` configs to the new `dedicated_pool` model. want a couple of language SDK examples (Ruby requested by a customer) + a short mapping table.

Tess M: SGTM. keep the cheat-sheet micro  two columns: old key -> new key and one-line why. customers like copy-paste.

Vikram S: runtime confirm: preemptible:true in old model maps to eviction_policy: 'preempt' in dedicated_pool, but behavior changed slightly (grace window reduced). i'll add a one-sentence runtime note.

Noor A: Support asked for an explicit rollback example and a CLI that does the mapping automatically. can we add `rw migrate-reserved --id $POOL --preview` ?

Owen R: yes. draft content below. cheat-sheet header + mapping table (short) + Ruby SDK example + rollback hint.

Owen R: Mapping (quick):
- reserved_pool.max -> dedicated_pool.target.max
- reserved_pool.min -> dedicated_pool.target.min
- reserved_pool.preemptible (bool) -> dedicated_pool.eviction_policy = "preempt" / "retain"
- reserved_pool.cooldown_s -> dedicated_pool.scale_policy.cooldown (seconds)

Tess M: add a short line explaining cooldown units and that new schema nests target.min/ max.

Owen R: Ruby SDK example (1-liner style):
```ruby
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Dedicated.new
client.update_pool_scale_policy(pool_id, {
  target: { min: 2, max: 20 },
  scale_policy: { cooldown: 300, eviction_policy: 'retain' }
})
```

Vikram S: runtime-approved note to add: "eviction_policy:'retain' preserves warm replicas for KV cache; 'preempt' will evict sooner. timing differs from legacy preemptible flag — check your KV-sensitive workloads." use that exact phrasing.

Noor A: CLI preview + migrate examples: `rw migrate-reserved --id $POOL --preview` shows a diff; `rw migrate-reserved --id $POOL --apply` writes the dedicated_pool config. Add a rollback example: `rwctl pool patch --id $POOL --set backup.from=previous_config`

Owen R: small rollback caveat: migration does not rewind capacity billing; add a line under SLA: "Note: migration or rollback does not credit prior capacity usage." link to SLA page.


docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5609 branch: docs/migrate/reserved-to-dedicated-cheatsheet 

Tess M: quick localization note: avoid region-specific sample values in snippets (use $REGION, $POOL) so translations don't accidentally leak envs.

Vikram S: CI link-checker flagged a stale link in the draft pointing to docs/dedicated/reserved.md. replace with /docs/dedicated/migration/reserved-to-dedicated.md in the PR.

Owen R: fixed the link in the branch and pushed. action items: (1) me: tidy copy + add short table row about eviction timing, (2) Vikram: confirm runtime sentence in review, (3) Noor: verify CLI preview output for support KB. target: merge by EOD.

docs-bot: CI: lint OK, link-checker now green for affected files.

Noor A: validated `rw migrate-reserved --preview` outputs expected diff on staging CLI. I'll paste a short sample in the KB after merge.

Tess M: small editorial nit: change "cheat-sheet" to "quick migration guide" in the header for tone.

Owen R: done. merging after one more quick pass. :shipit:

docs-bot: PR merged (5609) by Owen R  deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/migration/quick-guide-reserved-to-dedicated.html

Vikram S: checked staging. runtime sentence present and accurate. left a tiny punctuation nit in PR notes.

Noor A: support KB updated with preview output. will schedule a short 15-min office hours to walk customers through the migrate tool next week.

Owen R: thanks all  closing thread.
